items.title: 新 EIP：永久关闭 EOA 委托
items.note: （nicolashw，EIP-8476 讨论帖 23:35）。EOA 通过一种原本无效的、授权列表为空的 type-4 自发交易安装一个不可执行的代码标记，之后任何授权（包括清除授权）都不能替换它；EVM 把标记当作空代码（`EXTCODESIZE` 为 0），账户对合约来说仍是普通 EOA。动机是机构钱包、交易所热钱包和金库用不到委托执行，其操作控制可能默认它不存在；它不能防御私钥泄露。
items.title_en: New EIP: permanent EOA delegation opt-out
items.note_en: (nicolashw, EIP-8476 discussion thread, 23:35). An EOA installs a non-executable code marker through a previously invalid type-4 self-transaction with an empty authorization list, after which no authorization, including a clearing one, can replace it. The EVM treats the marker as empty code (`EXTCODESIZE` is 0), so the account remains an ordinary EOA to contracts. The motivation is that institutional wallets, exchange hot wallets and treasuries do not need delegated execution and their operational controls may assume it is unavailable; it does not protect against private key compromise.
items.topic_en: The Binance incident and the security boundary of EIP-7702

items.title: 新 EIP：绑定近期区块的委托授权
items.note: （dangerousfood，EIP-8477）。未使用的 7702 授权目前没有协议层的新鲜度限制，只要 nonce 对得上就能一直用；提案要求每个授权签入执行区块号和区块头哈希，只在该区块属于包含区块前 256 个祖先时有效，激活后拒绝旧格式授权，不影响已安装的委托。
items.title_en: New EIP: recent block bound delegation authorizations
items.note_en: (dangerousfood, EIP-8477). Unused 7702 authorizations currently have no protocol-enforced freshness bound and stay usable whenever the nonce matches. The proposal has each authorization sign an execution block number and header hash and apply only while that block is one of the inclusion block's preceding 256 ancestors; legacy unanchored authorizations are rejected after activation, and installed delegations are unaffected.
items.topic_en: The Binance incident and the security boundary of EIP-7702

items.title: EIP-8141：明确对预编译的 EXTCODEHASH 限制
items.note: （yperbasis）。按 EIP-1052，空的预编译账户 `EXTCODEHASH` 返回 0，转入 1 wei 后变成 `keccak256("")`，一笔转账就能让大量待处理 frame 交易失效；提议在验证阶段禁止对活跃预编译做 `EXTCODEHASH`。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: clarify EXTCODEHASH restrictions for precompiles
items.note_en: (yperbasis). Under EIP-1052, an empty precompile account returns 0 from `EXTCODEHASH`, and sending it 1 wei changes the result to `keccak256("")`, so one transfer can invalidate many pending frame transactions; the draft bans `EXTCODEHASH` of active precompiles during validation.

summary_en: Binance suffered a $6.3B security incident, and about $3B was frozen within hours. Rumors blamed EIP-7702, but Derek Chiang and Martin Köppelmann both said 7702 itself is not broken and was only used to carry out the attack efficiently. Two new 7702 proposals appeared the same day: EIP-8476 lets an EOA permanently disable delegation, and EIP-8477 requires authorizations to be anchored to a block within the last 256.
